messages:
zoe: deploy-bot starting staged rollout v4.0.0 -> canary 3% (us-west-1). change window until 21:00 UTC. watch gen/embeds :eyes:
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started: v4.0.0 -> canary=3% | regions=[us-west-1] | CL#6001
marc: spotted an increase in embed latency p95 from 240ms -> 610ms in canary group at ~t+7m, small sample set
ida: linking trace: https://telemetry.redwood/trace/6001-embed-lag
ida: logs show repeated reconnects to redis shard 2; kube shows no OOM but socket errors
sre-bot: node ip-10-0-9-3: sockets close high; kernel logs indicate ephemeral port exhaustion hints
marc: could be connection pool change in v4.0.0. did we change pool defaults?
zoe: build notes: bumped pool.max_per_host from 50->200 (CL#5997) to improve throughput
ida: that would increase ephemeral port usage on busy node. mitigation options: (1) pause progression and pin pool back to 50 (fast config CL#6002), (2) apply NAT port increase on nodes (infra work), (3) isolate canary traffic to additional nodes
zoe: prefer option (1) then (3) if needed. @deploy-bot freeze progression and add changelog note: "hold: embed p95 regression; investigating connection pool change"
deploy-bot: action queued: freeze rollout progression. canary remains at 3%. notifications sent to #eng-oncall #eng-releases
marc: preparing CL#6002 to revert pool setting and push canary image. ETA ~11m
ida: ops: please avoid autoscaler adding more replicas to the canary group until we validate
sre-bot: autoscaler hold applied for group=inf-canary-usw1 for 20m
ida: smoke plan: run 200 embeds short+long against pinned image. smoke command: ./smoke_embed.sh --env=canary --samples=200
marc: CL#6002 merged; image rolled: inf-runtime:pool50-6002 -> rolling restart beginning
ida: quick smoke: p95 latency back to ~250ms on sample window, no reconnects during run
zoe: consensus: hold at 3%, pin pool back, extended validation 20m. if clean, resume to 10%. if regressions reappear, rollback to v3.9.x full. thumbs? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
marc: :+1:
ida: :+1: will keep monitoring and post any anomalies
zoe: I'll update release notes with hold and mitigation steps and tag this thread for postmortem if rollback required. thanks all.
